hook: We've all been told that saving money is the way to get rich. But money sitting in a bank account almost never builds real wealth, and over decades it can quietly make you poorer. In this video I explain why from three angles: the numbers (inflation, the growth gap, the savings ceiling), the psychology that keeps people stuck as savers, and a six-move playbook to turn savings into wealth.
tags: why saving alone won't make you rich
